verdict.rationale: A robotics platform could plausibly offer querying and export of collected robot data, so this axis applies. However, the evidence covers only synthetic data generation (Replicator), capturing sensor data in simulation, and converting teleoperation demonstrations for GR00T post-training. None of it documents a query API, SQL interface, or export mechanism for offline analysis of collected robot data, and the OpenAPI probe found no API spec. Data generation and model-training pipelines are adjacent capabilities and earn no credit toward this story.
